lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white line segments. Spacing is generally uniform across the central torso, becoming more closely packed with shorter segments in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Y-shaped bifurcations are visible at the dorsal terminations of the second and third primary lines from the anterior. A merging of two faint segments occurs at the base of the neck-shoulder transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments at the far anterior and posterior (segments 1, 11, and 12) terminate before reaching the ventral or dorsal boundaries. Segment 10 exhibits a distinct mid-lateral gap, breaking the vertical continuity.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower haunch. The highest density is observed in the region directly posterior to the final continuous vertical line.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A sequence of three spots on the mid-posterior haunch aligns to form a horizontal geometric row parallel to the ventral torso line.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white patches on the face: one small circular spot below the eye and a larger elliptical patch on the lower cheek. Distinct white transverse patches are visible on the anterior surface of the lower limbs above the hooves.
